headline: Zoetis Q1 Adj. EPS $0.88 Beats $0.79 Estimate, Sales $1.455B Beat $1.45B Estimate
explanation: beating both adjusted eps (notably by ~11%) and revenues (albeit slightly) generally supports more positive investor sentiment unless offset by weak guidance or other negatives.

headline: Wedbush Downgrades Zumiez Inc. - Common Stock to Underperform
explanation: a reputable analyst downgrade to 'underperform' signals expected weaker future performance and typically prompts negative investor sentiment and selling pressure for zumiez shares.
